t: Can Cursor AI Read Jupyter Notebook Cells?
s: Cursor AI's Claude demonstrates an evolving ability to interpret Jupyter Notebooks, distinguishing between code and Markdown cells based on file export formats, but struggles with real-time cell output visualization, treating it akin to a terminal's privacy limitations.
sub: Jupyter Notebook cell parsing (execution count vs. index)
Distinguishing code cells from Markdown cells in .ipynb exports
Cursor AI's limitations in reading live Jupyter Notebook cell output
Comparison of Cursor AI's notebook parsing to terminal privacy concerns
